question: What is the meaning of recyclability in relation to recovery?
description:
Recyclability refers to the ability of a product to be recycled at a similar level of quality to the original input materials. It involves the potential for a product to be broken down and reformed into new products, with the aim of reducing waste and conserving resources. In relation to recovery, recyclability indicates the feasibility of recovering materials from a product and transforming them into new products or materials, while maintaining a comparable level of quality. This process helps in reducing the environmental impact of products and promotes a circular economy. <|ENDINPUT>
